botcomponent.description: Searches the web for upcoming sporting events, large concerts, local festivals and U.S. federal public holidays in a store's city for a forecast window, shows them with dates and sources, asks the user to confirm events, and passes confirmed events and the holidays to the forecast. Use at the start of an inventory forecast, or when a retail manager asks about upcoming events, games, concerts, holidays or what is happening near a store, because Event Data may be out of date and has no holiday information. Not for stock, prices, costs, baseline demand or sales boosts, which always come from Dataverse.
botcomponent.name: local-events-search
